findings.message: The test-reaching data is empty for every production symbol this Story changed, including those named tests clearly call: frameLabel and buildCallSequenceIR (call-sequence-label tests); code-ref-script.ts, renderCompanionPage, buildHtml and assembleFallbackShell (code-ref-script page tests); and createDocsReviewHost's frame-message path (review-frame-message tests). Tests that are present and call these symbols contradict the empty data, so it reads as a gap in the graph's test edges for newly added test files, not as missing coverage. It is not reported as a HIGH not-exercised breach. Re-check after re-indexing, or confirm by running the four test files. Many listed symbols in fallback.ts, shell.ts and docs-review-panel.ts are untouched neighbours in changed files and are out of scope.
